bio.text: Dave Yaccarino Sr. has represented Connecticut's 87th House District since 2011 and is the Republican candidate for the seat on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
He earned an A.A. in liberal sciences from Gateway Community College and served in the U.S. Navy Reserve.
His professional experience includes work as a U.S. history teacher and as owner of DJ's Sports Collectible and Comics.
